name.full: Documentation Fabric — ask it, and see what it holds

description.short: Ask the fabric who owns a document, and see the corpus drawn.
description.full: The Documentation Fabric knows what the organisation has written, who owns it, whether it was approved and what it is about. Ask it in chat — who owns this, is it approved, what does this change affect, how do we know. The tab draws every record and the concepts it is about, redrawn each time you open it. The fabric holds no document content: it points at the system of record, which decides who may read it.

//nobot: NO BOT, and it is a CONSTRAINT rather than a choice (measured 11 Oct 2026). Declaring a `botId` obliges the manifest to carry `webApplicationInfo` so Teams can sign the user in; that needs an identifier URI, an `access_as_user` scope and the two Teams clients pre-authorised on the BOT'S Entra app. A Copilot Studio agent has no application registration in the tenant — only a Microsoft-managed ServiceIdentity service principal — so none of it can be added. Declaring it anyway made Teams key the agent's existing conversation to THIS app, which renamed the chat and left the agent (Integrated auth, trigger Always) unable to sign anyone in, so its MCP tools were never available and the orchestrator fell through to knowledge, Escalate and Fallback. The agent keeps its own Copilot Studio-published Teams app for chat; this app is the picture.
//key: The app's OWN key rides these URLs. It is not MCP_SHARED_SECRET — this is a browser surface, not an MCP server, and a value in a URL reaches a manifest zip, a browser history and a referrer header. The manifest only ever travels inside the tenant, so the gate keeps the internet out, not colleagues, which is exactly the threat model a tab has.
//staticTabs: The picture, per person. Teams gives this one no configuration step, so it is the surface a researcher opens without being added to anything.
//configurableTabs: ...and the same picture in a channel, which is where a team looks at it together. The configuration page is MANDATORY: with none, Teams shows 'Not Found' with Save disabled and cancels the add (measured on the meeting app, 6 Oct 2026).
